info.name: Quantum Chess
info.summary: Chess with superposition, entanglement and measurement — play friends, the computer or an AI
info.description:
**Quantum Chess** brings quantum mechanics to the chessboard, right inside your Nextcloud.
Pieces can be in two places at once. A knight can **split** into a superposition, a bishop can **merge** back together, sliding pieces become **entangled** with the pieces that may or may not block their way, and every capture is a **measurement** that collapses the board into one reality. You win by capturing the enemy king — there is no check, only probability.
### Game modes - 👥 **Online multiplayer** against other users of your Nextcloud, with invitations, notifications, in-game chat, draw offers, rematches and an Elo leaderboard - 🤖 **Play the computer** – a built-in quantum-aware engine with five difficulty levels that runs in your browser - ✨ **Play an AI (LLM)** – challenge a large language model with its own personality. Use **Nextcloud Assistant** (the AI provider configured by your administrator), or bring your own key for any OpenAI-compatible API (OpenAI, Mistral, OpenRouter, Groq, Gemini, Ollama, LocalAI…) or Anthropic Claude - 🪑 **Pass & play** on one device
### AI trainer - Interactive lessons that teach superposition, splitting, merging, entanglement and measurement step by step - Puzzles with instant feedback - A coach with an evaluation bar, hints, threat warnings, move-quality feedback and an AI coach you can ask questions about the position - Post-game review with an evaluation graph
### Polished and native - Built with Nextcloud's own design components; follows your theme, dark mode and language - Probability badges, heat maps and entanglement highlighting to visualise the quantum state - Smooth animations and optional sound effects - Keyboard accessible, responsive on phone, tablet and desktop - Dashboard widget showing the games where it is your turn
API keys you enter are stored encrypted on your Nextcloud server and are never sent to your browser.
